newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 30.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Fiscal reform panel recommends 10 percent annual cut in subsidies to local governments.
-- Nomura Securities Co Ltd former president Hideo Sakamaki ordered halt to in-house probe into corporate racketeer scandal.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto signals readiness to extend emergency food aid to North Korea.
-- Tokyo District Court prosecutors to question Nomura Securities Co Ltd former president Sakamaki on payoff to corporate racketeers.
-- Atomic Energy Commission's panel recommends burying nuclear fuel waste by private companies.
-- U.S. Pentagon official calls for inspection of hostile ships by Maritime Self-Defence Force warships in high seas around Japan.
-- Text of killer's message bared in Kobe murder case.
